technical.summary: MMM shows oversold conditions but lacks bullish confirmation; multiple bearish patterns, weak momentum, and price below all key moving averages suggest downtrend continuation rather than reversal setup.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 35 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional signals with no composite conviction; fear sentiment (37) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII reading limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (81.6) indicates extreme fear, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, FOMC event in 1 day adds binary risk, and earnings in 35 days creates additional uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI) combined with fear-zone sentiment (37) and price near support (77.84) create a contrarian bounce setup if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 81.6, strong dollar), price below all major moving averages, three black crows pattern, negative momentum (MACD, CMF, AO), FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings risk in 35 days create compounding downside risks that overshadow oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals and fear-zone sentiment create contrarian appeal, but severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC event tomorrow) and negative momentum across all indicators eliminate margin of safety. Risk/reward is unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC announcement in 1 day combined with VIX at crisis levels (81.6) creates binary volatility risk that could gap through support; inverted yield curve signals recession headwinds for industrials sector.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk all score weak-to-moderate with bear debate winner at high confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 6 positions in Industrials sector; adding MMM increases concentration risk during macro stress without offsetting conviction signal.
